FOLIO NO. 09 · STILL UNDER REVIEW
Casa Encinal, between fog and fire.

Of all the houses in the portfolio, Casa Encinal is the one we most often photograph at four in the afternoon. A pillar of fog hangs over the marshlands by then, and the cellar runs cold lavender. We're keeping it without booking for the season.
